mods.name: Blockgame Enhanced
mods.description:
Fixes a lot of client-side issues and adds a ton of quality-of-life features for the Blockgame server.
The Blockgame Enhanced mod uses music from Heartbound, which was paid for and licensed from Pirate Software for non-commercial use.
Play Blockgame at: mc.blockgame.info
